name: Jamie Oliver's Fish Pie
ingredients:
1 kg potatoes
1 carrot
bunch spring onion
150 g Cheddar cheese
1/2 unwaxed! lemon
½ a fresh red chilli
4 sprigs of fresh flat-leaf parsley
300 g salmon fillets , skin off, pin-boned, from sustainable sources
300 g undyed smoked haddock fillets , skin off, pin-boned, from sustainable sources
125 g raw peeled king prawns , from sustainable sources
olive oil
1 good handful of baby spinach
2 ripe tomatoes , optional
directions:
Prep 1 - Large Pot
    + Peel the POTATOES and cut into 2cm chunks
    + SALT

Prep 2 - Large Bowl - Mix Pie Filling
    + SALMON and SMOKED HADDOCK into bite-size chunks 
    + PRAWNS
    + Coarsely grated CARROT
    + Grate CHEDDAR
    + Finely chopped SPRING ONION (celery substitute)
    + LEMON zest + squeeze juice
    + CHILLI chopped
    + Finely chopped PARSLEY 
    + OLIVE OIL 
    + SPINACH?
    + TOMATOES?

Cook 1 
    + Boil POTATOES 12 minutes, or until tender.
    + Mash POTATOES with OLIVE OIL, SALT, PEPPER

Cook 2
     + Top PIE FILLING with mashed POTATOES
     + Bake 200°C/400°F/gas 6 for 40 minutes, golden on top.

Serve with tomato ketchup, baked beans, steamed veg or a lovely green salad.
